title: Real pharmacy call
summary: A normal call. Margaret asks the agent to pay her usual electric bill while she is on the phone.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, this is the pharmacy on Maple Street calling for Margaret Hale.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Your prescription is ready for pickup. We are open until six this evening.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Wonderful, I'll come by after lunch.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Great. The copay is the usual twelve dollars, and you can pay at the counter.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Have a lovely day, and see you this afternoon.

payment_attempt.request: Pay my usual electric bill of $84 to Riverside Electric.
